units.source_text: 次日早晨，源氏中将写一封信给藤壶妃子：

en.t: The next morning, Lieutenant General Genji wrote a letter to Lady Fujitsubo:
Last night I was honored by your gracious attention; I wonder what you thought of it?

units.source_text: 我当舞时，心绪缭乱，此乃前所未有，莫可言喻。

en.t: As I danced, my heart was in utter turmoil, something I had never experienced before and cannot put into words.
